title: Ilizwi Elivela Enzonzobileni
intro: Ibali lomonde nenceba engenamda yoThixo livela kwiQuran. Isithunywa sathunyelwa kwisixeko esikhulu, kodwa abantu babo basila isilumkiso baza bala inyaniso. Bedanile, lo mphefumlo wemka - ukuze uvavanywe lulwandle olushushu kwaye uginywe nzulu kakhulu. Esiswini sobumnyama, kwavela isicelo esithobekileyo, kwaye uSozinceba waphendula. Ngubani lo mphefumlo owavela eguqukile, obantu bakhe babeza kuba ngamakholwa angaphezu kwekhulu lamawaka?
clues: Ndathunyelwa njengomlumkisi kwisixeko esikhulu esinabemi abaphambukile kwindlela yokholo.
Ndibize abantu bam inyaniso ngokuphindaphindiweyo, kodwa bahlekisa baza balamkela isigidimi sam.
Ndasuka kubo ndidanile ngaphambi kokuba ndifumane imvume, ndaya elwandle oluvulekileyo.
Kwavela isivuthuvuthu esikhulu, ndaza ndaphoswa elwandle — ndaza ndaginywa ndiphelele sisidalwa esikhulu saselwandle.

Ngaphakathi kobumnyama — ubunzulu bolwandle, isisu sesidalwa, kunye nomgangatho wolwandle onzulu — ndadanduluka ndathi: ‘Akukho thixo ngaphandle kwakho; uzuko malube kuwe; bendiphakathi kwabenzi bobubi.’
U-Allah wandihlangula kwiinzulu, kwaye xa ndibuya, abantu bam abangaphezu kwekhulu lamawaka babesele beyamkele inyaniso.

arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَتْ قَرْيَةٌ ءَامَنَتْ فَنَفَعَهَآ إِيمَـٰنُهَآ إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّآ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْخِزْىِ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
verse: Then has there not been a [single] city that believed so its faith benefited it except the people of Jonah? When they believed, We removed from them the punishment of disgrace in worldly life and gave them enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time. (10:98)
